evidence.text: Tallyroute helps wholesale distributors with 30 to 200 field sales reps plan daily visit routes and log orders from a mobile app.
Tallyroute costs €29 per sales rep per month. All prices exclude VAT.
Tallyroute exports orders to the most common ERP systems through CSV files and a REST API.
